title: Barometer
source_docs: UAV Toolbox/UAV Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Barometer.md
text: Barometer sensor model with noise, 1 input, 1 output; {Constant bias} sets the constant measurement bias, {Noise density} sets the white noise standard variance, {Bias instability} sets the correlated noise standard variance, {Decay factor} sets the correlated noise decay factor, {Seed} sets the random number initial seed and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Noise density
params.values: White noise standard variance 1 (default) | nonnegative finite scalar

params.name: Bias instability
params.values: Correlated noise standard variance 1 (default) | nonnegative finite scalar

params.name: Decay factor
params.values: Correlated noise decay factor 0.99 (default) | positive scalar in the range (0,1)

params.name: Seed
params.values: Random number initial seed 67 (default) | nonnegative integer scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
